sn14.32:1.2: tatra kho bhagavā … paṭhavīdhātu yāhaṃ bhikkhave assādapariyesanaṃ acariṃ yo paṭhavīdhātuyā assādo tadajjhagamaṃ yāvatā paṭhavīdhātuyā assādo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
sn14.32:1.3: paṭhavīdhātuyāhaṃ bhikkhave ādīnavapariyesanaṃ acariṃ yo paṭhavīdhātuyā ādīnavo tadajjhagamaṃ yāvatā paṭhavīdhātuyā ādīnavo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
sn14.32:1.4: paṭhavīdhātuyāhaṃ bhikkhave nissaraṇa pariyesanaṃ acariṃ yaṃ paṭhavīdhātuyā nissaraṇaṃ tadajjhagamaṃ yāvatā paṭhavīdhātuyā nissaraṇaṃ paññāya me taṃ sudiṭṭhaṃ.
sn14.32:2.3: vāyodhātuyāhaṃ bhikkhave assādapariyesanaṃ acariṃ yo vāyodhātuyā assādo tadajjhagamaṃ yāvatā vāyodhātuyā assādo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
sn14.32:2.4: vāyodhātuyāhaṃ bhikkhave ādīnavapariyesanaṃ acariṃ yo vāyodhātuyā ādīnavo tadajjhagamaṃ yāvatā vāyodhātuyā ādīnavo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
sn14.32:2.5: vāyodhātuyāhaṃ bhikkhave nissaraṇapariyesanaṃ acariṃ yaṃ vāyodhātuyā nissaraṇaṃ tadajjhagamaṃ yāvatā vāyodhātuyā nissaraṇaṃ paññāya me taṃ sudiṭṭhaṃ.
sn14.32:3.1: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ catunnaṃ dhātūnaṃ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ na abbhaññāsiṃ neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
sn14.32:4.1: yato ca khvāhaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ catunnaṃ dhātūnaṃ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ athāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
sn14.32:4.3: akuppā me vimutti ayamantimā jāti natthidāni punabbhavoti.
